mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(salestime, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(number * price) AS totalSales, SUM(number) AS salesCount FROM bus_sales GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(salestime, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT g.goodsname AS category, SUM(s.number * s.price) AS totalSales, SUM(s.number) AS salesCount FROM bus_sales s LEFT JOIN bus_goods g ON s.goodsid = g.id GROUP BY g.goodsname ORDER BY totalSales DESC

SELECT c.customername AS customer, SUM(s.number * s.price) AS totalSales, SUM(s.number) AS salesCount FROM bus_sales s LEFT JOIN bus_customer c ON s.customerid = c.id GROUP BY c.customername ORDER BY totalSales DESC
